description: Install the reviewed Homebrew sf formula only after explicit system-change acknowledgement, then persist the verified absolute sf_cli_path without hiding a restart or reload boundary.
embedding_description: Provision a missing local Salesforce sf command for this plugin when a user has approved the exact Homebrew system change. This process probes first, never reinstalls a compliant executable, binds the verified absolute path into Salesforce plugin configuration, and does not perform Salesforce browser login or contact an org.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Bounded local provisioning verdict with whether Homebrew installed sf, its verified absolute executable path, version, and the explicit configuration boundary.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: State whether sf was newly installed or already present, and state that the plugin configuration was rebound without a hidden reload or restart. Do not represent this as Salesforce authentication.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Provision and bind the local Salesforce CLI under explicit system-change consent.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.provision_consent_required means no package install or executable-binding update was authorized. sf.not_configured means Homebrew, its reviewed sf plus Node plan, the post-install version probe, or the ordinary plugin configuration update could not be completed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For sf.provision_consent_required, obtain explicit acknowledgement and repeat. For sf.not_configured, repair the named local prerequisite, ensure Homebrew plans only sf plus Node without upgrades or removals, then retry; browser login remains a separate operator step.
